Commentary.Commentary: Josh Hazlewood then got rid of Cheteshwar Pujara for 92 and castled Ashwin with one that kept low. Umesh Yadav threw his wicket away but the pair of Ishant Sharma and Wriddhiman Saha added vital 16 runs before the former threw it away at the stroke of lunch. India have set a target of 188 runs for Australia. Batting has not been easy but Australia will know this is their best chance to retain the Border-Gavaskar trophy, this time in India. The hosts will want to bank on the conditions to help them as they aim to stay alive in the series. Join us in a while for what should be an interesting chase.

That was yet another fascinating session of Test cricket! Australia have done brilliantly to bowl India out in this session. The hosts began cautiously, adding runs slowly but gradually. Australia knew they had to do something special and they did, with the second new ball. Starc rapped Rahane in front just after the batsman got to his fifty and that triggered the collapse. He then dismissed Karun Nair for a golden duck and almost took a hat-trick.

OUT! Ishant throws it away! Tossed up delivery outside off, Sharma prods forward and drives the ball straight to the fielder at short extra cover. Shaun Marsh makes no mistake as he pounces on it diving forward. Ishant will be really unhappy with his shot after playing well till then. With this wicket, the Indian innings comes to an end as they finish on 274. Lunch has been taken as well.

NOT OUT! Dropped! Short delivery into the body, Saha goes for a pull but mistimes it over the bowler's head. Warner comes running in from mid off and dives towards his right to catch it. He cannot hold onto it and the ball ricochets towards the fielder at mid off. Handscomb there picks it up and has a throw at the non-striker's end. Ishant reacts really late but just manages to plonk his bat in time. So a double reprieve for India.
Saha's catch is dropped but there is run out appeal against Ishant Sharma at the non-striker's end. Looks safe.

Ball Tracker shows that the ball pitched in line, impact was also in line too but the ball was just clipping the leg stump. So, the umpire's decision stands and Ishant Sharma is safe.

Pitch Report - Sunil Gavaskar says that yesterday was a cracker of a day. Feels that this wicket is going to remain two paced throughout the contest. Mentions that the ball will turn and bounce, with the odd ball keeping low. Also adds that the inconsistency in bounce will be lethal as the cracks will keep getting wider as the day progresses. Brett Lee feels that Starc should bowl from the Beml end, Ishant Sharma really looked threatening from that end as he kept bowling on a back of a length area. Sunil Gavaskar feels that India would be looking to add a minimum of hundred runs on the board to pull the game back in their favour. (Talking about the new ball) Opines that the Aussies should wait for a while, to check if the old ball is doing any tricks and then go for the new ball. Ends by saying that it would be an exciting game of cricket for sure with both the teams still in the contest.

Having gained a lead of 87, Australia would have hoped to run through the Indian batting line-up again but KL Rahul kept them at bay with a fine fifty. After his dismissal, India did lose their way a bit but the pair of Cheteshwar Pujara and Ajinkya Rahane showing great skills to survive the day. India currently lead by 126 runs and will know they need to add at least 100 more runs to start fancying their chances. Australia will come out hard knowing that chasing won't be that easy. It promises to be another intriguing day of cricket. Stay tuned for all the action.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the fourth day of the second Test between India and Australia at the M.Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru. Well many of us didn't quite expect the game to go into the penultimate day, did we? When Indian were bundled out for 189 and the pitch offering a lot of assistance then, it looked like we may be in for a quick game but it was not to be. Both teams have applied themselves well, especially India who have done well to stay in the game.
... DAY 4, Session 1....

It should be an exciting day tomorrow. India will want their batsmen to pile up as many runs as possible so that they pose a target in excess of 250. Australia, on the other hand, will aim to not allow India get away with the game as batting last on this track won't be easy. Join us at 0930 local (0400 GMT) for the fourth day of the second Test match. Until then, goodbye and take care.

For the hosts, KL Rahul managed to keep his good run of form going with the bat as he registered yet another half century but had to depart to some brilliance by Steven Smith. When Jadeja was bowled, India were effectively 33/4. The pair of Pujara and Rahane then brought India back with a steady unbeaten stand of 93 runs.

India trailing by 87 runs, began well before they were pegged back by Josh Hazlewood. He was the pick of the Australian bowlers who managed to pick up three wickets in the day. The Virat Kohli dismissal was marginal but he won't complain about it. Lyon could not replicate his first innings performance and his skipper will want him to turn things around tomorrow.

The game is now even stevens as the hosts lead by 126 runs. India will be really happy after finally dominating a day of Test cricket in this series. They came out firing in the morning where a beautiful spell by Jadeja sent the visitors back in the hut in just over half a session, taking 6/63.

Finally a promising session for India where they didn't lose a single wicket. Pujara and Rahane looked settled in the middle as they played out the final session with grit and determination. The former marched on to register another fifty under his name. Rahane has been solid and that will please the hosts. The pair managed to stitch the best partnership until now in this series which speaks volumes about their temperament. All the Australian bowlers tried their level best but could not build pressure on the hosts when they were struggling at 120/4.
On a length outside off, Rahane stays in his crease and punches it to the left of the fielder at point. He wants a single but is sent back. That's Stumps, Day 3! India lead by 126 runs.

With the right-handed batsmen struggling vs Lyon, India sent in Ravindra Jadeja as the pinch-hitter but the move backfired as Josh Hazlewood who had dismissed Kohli earlier, got through the defences of Jadeja too. The lead is only 35 runs and India will know they have a lot of hard work left to be done. It promises to be another intriguing session of cricket. Join us in a while for it.

What an eventful session of Test cricket and Australia finish on top, having taken four wickets for 84 runs! Indians had a very good first hour post Lunch with KL Rahul and Cheteshwar Pujara going smoothly. And it was the skipper Steven Smith who led from the front for the visitors. It was his brilliance at first slip, taking a stunner to send back KL Rahul. The runs started to dry up and pressure started to mount, thanks to some disciplined bowling. Virat Kohli came in and looked to be positive before a marginal call went against him and India were in trouble.
Angling into the stumps, Rahane stays deep in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at mid on. And that's Tea on Day 3.

OUT! That is a big call from Nigel Long! Angling in from a length, keeps a touch low, Kohli looks to defend it. The ball hits him on the pads and there is a mild appeal by the bowler. Surprisingly, the umpire raises his finger and Kohli is quick to go for the review. Replays show that the bat was too close to the pad but the television umpire could not find any conclusive evidence to over rule the on-field decision. So they move to the Ball Tracker which shows that the ball pitched outside off, the impact was umpire's call and was hitting the stumps. That means the on-field call stays and Virat has to walk back. The poor form of the Indian skipper continues. Replays show there was also a direct hit at the striker's end but because it happened after Kohli was given out, it did not count. The Indian captain though is not happy as he walks off, pointing towards his bat. A big moment in the game, though. India are 25/3 effectively!

Tossed up outside off, Pujara looks to play at first but then reacts well to the extra spin by playing outside the line. The ball goes off the body wide of the leg gully fielder.
Shorter on the stumps, Rahul clips it over backward square leg for a single.
Rahul backs off at the last moment and is sorry to Lyon, Wade, everyone around.
Lands it on off, Rahul is watchful and defends it.
Fuller on off, Rahul gets across and turns it towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller on the stumps, Rahul covers the line and turns it towards leg gully.
Lands it outside off, Rahul gets across and defends it.
Angles it on the stumps, Rahul clips it through square leg for a single.
Slants it on a length outside off, Rahul stays back and defends it.
Shorter in length angling into the body, Rahul is cramped for room with the angle so he arches back and looks to flay it over the keeper but misses. That was risky from KL.
Outside off on a length, Rahul comes forward and pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Poor line and punished! Fuller and angling into the pads, Rahul does not miss out and clips it to the fine leg fence. Vital boundary for India, they trail by 23 runs.
Edged! Fuller outside off, Rahul looks to go for the expansive drive but gets an outside edge which does not carry to the gully fielder.
Starc is warming up.
Rahul stays back and works it through backward square leg for a single.
Rahul gets right in line and defends it watchfully.
Lands it outside off, Rahul looks to sweep it but misses. There is an appeal for an lbw but it was way outside the line.
Fuller outside off, Rahul goes back and looks to counter the low bounce.
Lands it outside off, Rahul looks to clip but misses. The ball goes off the pads to the short leg fielder and they appeal but there was no bat there.
Shorter outside off, Rahul gets across and defends it back down the wicket.
Angles it on a fuller length just around off, Pujara defends it off the inside half towards short mid-wicket. Good comeback by the bowler after going for a boundary on the first ball.
Despite the low bounce on the previous ball, Pujara is right forward to this fuller ball outside off.
Good adjustment! Angles it on a back of a length outside off, keeps low, Pujara looks to get out of the way first but then spots the low bounce and dabs it towards the slip cordon off the gloves.
Fuller this time from Josh, Pujara pushes it back down the wicket. Hits it too straight and it hits the stumps at the non-striker's end.
Bowls from wide of the crease, angles it on a length just around off, Pujara gets behind the line and defends it.
FOUR! Nicely done! On a length outside off, Pujara follows the ball with hard hands and gets it wide of the gully fielder for a boundary to third man.
Fuller outside off, Rahul comes forward and pushes it covers.
Fuller outside off, turns in, Rahul defends it watchfully.
Flatter around off, keeps a touch low, Rahul goes back to work it through but gets it off the bottom edge back onto his pads.
Lands it outside off, Rahul strides forward and drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Floats it outside off on a fuller length, Rahul gets over the ball and blocks it out.
Lands it outside off, spins in, Rahul stays back and turns it towards the on side.
Bowls from wide of the crease, on a length on the stumps, Pujara defends it towards mid-wicket. He took the bottom hand off the bat, on that occasion.
Good length outside off, Rahul punches it through point for a single.
Fuller in length on off, Rahul comes forward and defends it.
1,000 runs for KL Rahul in Test cricket.
Fuller outside off, Rahul lunges into the drive and gets it through covers for a couple of runs.
Back of a length outside off, Rahul gets behind the line and defends it watchfully.
Angles it on a length just around off, Rahul defends it off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket.
A touch short outside off, Pujara goes back and pushes it towards the off side.
Lands it on off, Pujara comes down to turn it through mid-wicket but finds the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Rahul comes down the wicket and pushes it through mid on for a single. 50 up for India.
Bowls it on off, turned through square leg for a single.

Dropped!! Floats it outside off, Pujara plays the wrong line and gets an outside edge. Smith at first slip, sticks out his left hand to grab it but fails to hold onto the chance. That was a tough one, Smith is not happy. How much will it cost Australia?
Loopy outside off, Rahul gets over the ball and clips it through backward square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Pujara lunges forward a touch and pushes it towards mid on from his crease.
Shorter in length just around off, Rahul hops and tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Bowls this from wide of the crease, Rahul is watchful as he defends it from his crease.
Outside off on a fuller length, Rahul presses forward and pushes it to covers. They think of the single but Rahul sends Pujara back.
On a length outside off, Pujara guides it down to third man for a single.
Angles it on the stumps, Josh clips it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Pujara hits it back to the bowler. Lyon collects the ball and fires the throw with his left hand to make Pujara hurry back into his crease.
Floats it outside off, turns in, Pujara looks to turn it through mid-wicket but gets it off the edge. The ball falls wide of the short leg fielder.

Dropped? Tough chance. Lands it outside off, Pujara looks to play for the turn and is beaten as the ball does not turn that much. The ball goes off the edge and lobs off the keepers' pads. There is no one at silly point and a chance goes abegging.
Tossed up outside off, Pujara comes forward and drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Rahul lunges forward and pushes it into covers for a single.
Floats it outside off, Rahul comes forward and looks to defend but is hit on his front pad. There is an appeal for an lbw but that was never going to be given.
Nathan Lyon will bowl from the Pavilion end. A slip, a leg slip and a backward short leg in place.
On a length outside off, Rahul comes forward and guides it down to third man for a single.
Fuller and angling into the pads, Pujara works it through square leg for a single to get off the mark.
Cheteshwar Pujara will bat at number 3 for India.

OUT! Mukund has to walk back! Josh bowls it just around off, comes in a touch, Mukund's weight is back and hangs his bat out for it. He has played down the wrong line and is bowled. The off stump goes for the walk and Josh is pumped up. Mukund can stare all he want but he has to depart. Replays show the ball brushed the front pad on its way to the stumps. Australia have began in superb fashion.
On a length outside off, Rahul comes forward and pushes it to deep point for a single.
Fuller outside off, Rahul presses forward and pushes it into covers.
Starts off with a good length ball outside off, Rahul gets behind the line and defends it.

The players are back in the middle for the post-lunch session. KL Rahul and Abhinav Mukund will want to continue from where they left for India. Josh Hazlewood will start the proceedings with the ball for Australia.
.... DAY 3, SESSION 2 ....

Australia on the other hand, would have loved a wicket or two. The new ball bowlers sprayed it around a bit and they may feel India got off to a bit of a flier given the conditions. They though will back their plans, which have come off superbly so far in the series. A vital session to follow, promises to be an exciting one. Join us in a while for it.

India finally manage to take a session back. They first bundled out the Australians this morning, giving away only 39 runs. The Indian openers in KL Rahul and Abhinav Mukund then batted with a lot of positive intent. There were quick singles and an intent to put the bad balls away. India have not had a good opening stand in recent times and the start should please them to say the least. They are still 49 runs away from parity and will aim to wipe it out without losing any wicket if possible. Time is not an issue on this wicket yet.
That kept low! Lyon bowls it outside off, turns in and keeps low, Rahul manages to clip it towards backward square leg for a single. That's Lunch, Day 3!
Loopy outside off, Rahul gets across and defends it watchfully.
Mukund lunges forward and pushes it into covers for a single. Shaun Marsh at covers failed to stop the ball despite the dive and hence the single was possible.
Floats it on off, Mukund comes forward and defends it back down the wicket with an inside edge.
Works it through backward square leg for a single.
That spun! Floats it outside off, spins in sharply, Rahul lets it go through. Warner from leg gully leaps to his right to take it.
Tossed outside off, Mukund punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Floated outside off, Mukund prods forward in defence.
A shooter from Steve this time. Mukund does well to defend it.
Sprayed on the pads this time, Mukund flicks it this time towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Rahul cuts it past the fielder at point for a quick single.
Fired down the leg side, Rahul still goes to play at it.
That was close! Tossed up outside off, Mukund leaves it and the ball doesn't turn at all and whizzes past the off stump.
Fuller on the stumps, Mukund defends it back to the bowler.
Sharp turn from Lyon this time, Mukund shoulders his arms to it.
Mukund gets to the pitch of the ball as he defends it off the front foot.
Tossed outside off, left alone.
Spinning in from outside off, Rahul works it square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.

SIX! Top edge! Shorter in length on the stumps, Mukund looks to pull it through but gets a top edge which flies over the fine leg fence for a maximum. Starc does not like it and has a word with the batsman.
Banged in short again, Mukund stays back and defends it back down the wicket.
Shorter length down the leg side, Mukund fails to pull it through.
Low full toss outside off, Rahul pushes it towards mid off for a single. Warner got to the ball in a jiffy but the batsmen had done the running.
Length delivery outside off, left alone by Rahul.
Good length delivery angling into the batsman, Mukund stays deep in his crease and punches it through covers for a quick single.
On the pads, the ball keeps low. Rahul tries to clip it but misses as the ball hits him low on the pads.
In the air...safe! Spinning into the pads, Rahul defends it uppishly towards the mid-wicket region. The ball falls short of the fielder there.
Floated outside off, Abhinav cuts this one a bit wide of point. Warner dives to his left and makes a fine stop. The batsmen still manage to take a run.
Another short delivery angling into the pads, Mukund reads it well as he punches it towards mid on off the back foot.
Mukund stays deep in his crease and punches the short ball towards the fielder at mid off.
Tossed up outside off, Mukund prods forward and defends it towards the fielder at point.
Nathan Lyon introduced into the attack. Indians having an unofficial drinks break. He will be on Hat-Trick as he got two wickets off the two balls in the first innings.
Full length delivery angling into the pads, Abhinav clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
Short delivery angling into the body, Mukund thinks of swaying away from the line at first but the lack of bounce forced him to defend the ball towards the fielder at point.
On the pads this time, Rahul reads the length well and flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Slinging in from a length, Rahul gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Angling in from a length outside off, Rahul gets to the pitch of the ball to defend it.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahul stays in his crease and guides the ball through the point region for a couple.
Starc goes round the wicket.
Angled into the pads, Mukund tries to clip it on the leg side but misses. He gets hit high on the pads and there is a stifled appeal from the Aussies.
Again in the line of the stumps, Mukund uses his crease to defend the ball towards the fielder at mid on.
Angling into the stumps, the ball keeps a tad low. Mukund stays in his crease and somehow manages to defend it well.
Length delivery outside off, which has a good carry. Mukund shoulders his arms to it as Wade collects it face high.
Fuller delivery outside off, Rahul drops it front of point for a single.
Angling into the stumps, Rahul stays in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.

FOUR! Good shot! Full toss angled into the pads, Mukund puts his weight forward and elegantly clips it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary. He got to a similar ball in the first innings but did better this time around.
Good length delivery outside off, Mukund looks to defend but is squared up and gets a thick outside edge towards the fielder at gully. Marsh stops the ball and prevents the single.
Full and wide outside off, left alone by Mukund. The ball is like a lazy kid on a monday morning, just does not get up and shoots through to the keeper.
BYE! Fuller delivery outside off, Rahul tries to drive at it but the ball goes through between his bat and the body. Wade is unable to collect it as Mukund calls him through for a quick bye.
Length delivery just outside off, Rahul thinks of playing at it but takes his bat away from the line at the right time. The ball just bounced up after pitching.
Angling across from a length way outside off, Rahul is undisturbed by that line as he lets it go through straight to the keeper.

Angling across from a length, Mukund stays in his crease and punches it through the mid-wicket region to get off the mark. The batsmen run a couple as the mid-wicket fielder cannot stop it with a dive.
Down the leg side, Rahul stays in his crease and clips it towards the fielder ar fine leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Rahul guides it straight towards the fielder at point.

FOUR! Top shot! Full in the line of the stumps, Rahul just stays in his crease and pushes it straight down the ground as he shows the full face of the bat. The ball races away towards the fence through the mid on region.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahul shoulders his arms to it.
Hazlewood starts one with bowling way outside off, left alone by Rahul.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.
On the pads, Rahul clips it towards the fielder at mid on for a quick single to retain strike.
FOUR! Sprayed on the pads, Rahul clips it fine down the leg side for a boundary. That's the first for the day. Easy pickings for Rahul!

Loud shout for LBW! Length delivery angling into the stumps, Rahul gets an inside edge onto his pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. Good decision by the umpire as replays show that there was a thick inside edge.
Bye! Wide outside off and nipping away again, Mukund shoulders his arms to it. Wade cannot collect it well and the ball runs away behind him for a bye.
Good length delivery nipping away after pitching, Mukund tries to play at it but is totally beaten by the away movement.
Back of a length delivery down the leg side to start with from Starc, Rahul just clips it towards the fielder at fine leg to get off the mark with a single.
